fields.name: unused_0000
fields.meaning: Unused; zero (cleared when a new game starts)
fields.evidence: code 4000:038D clears 0x0000-0x77FF; zero in every save seen

fields.name: character_lists
fields.meaning: Eleven queues, one per character (record order as at 0x6019), each 170 entries of 9 bytes. Entry byte 0 is the type (0xFF = empty), byte 8 counts down on every shift (0xFF = stays), bytes 1-7 are unknown. Written straight to the cart memory, not covered by the check sum. All empty in the verified save
fields.evidence: code 4000:A550 fills with FF at new game; 4000:B23A/B260 read/write entry (character*1530 + n*9); 4000:B30D shifts the queue and ticks byte 8; 4000:BE33 counts non-empty heads; 4000:BFCD appends

fields.name: unused_41ce
fields.meaning: Unused; zero
fields.evidence: zero in every save seen; code 4000:038D clears it

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Save marker: the text -DIGITALPARTNER- (also stored in the game program). If it is missing the game treats the cart as having no save
fields.evidence: code 4000:0399 writes it at new game, 4000:02EE compares it at load; boot reads at 4000:02EF

fields.name: player_gender
fields.meaning: Player choice made at the start: 0 or 1. The default comes from the console owner profile (1 when the owner is registered as female) and left/right flips it before confirming
fields.evidence: code 4000:2027 (owner profile via system call) and 4000:230A (toggle); value 0 in the verified save

fields.name: player_name
fields.meaning: Name entered at the start, padded with 0xFF (character set not decoded)
fields.evidence: code 4000:221C copies the 8-byte name-entry buffer; constant across saves

fields.name: char[0].flags
fields.meaning: Status bits of the character: bit0 = belongs to the waiting group (set for records 7-11 from a fixed table, kept across days), bit1 = joined the player, bit2 = while set the game skips autosaving; 0xFF = no character (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0D20 (init from table), 4000:0FF9 (sets bit1/bit2), 4000:0327 (save skipped when bit2 set), 4000:0D75 (new day keeps bit0 only)

fields.name: char[0].character_id
fields.meaning: Which character this record is (fixed per record: 00, 04, 08, 0C, 10, 14, 18, 1D, 20, 23, 26) (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0D20 (ROM table 0D5F), 4000:1AF3 (status screen looks it up); constant across saves

fields.name: char[0].daily_value_a
fields.meaning: Daily value: set to 5 each morning, cleared to 0 when the character joins, drifts back toward 5 while waiting (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0D75 (sets 5), 4000:0FF9 (clears on join), 4000:107C (nudges toward 5)

fields.name: char[0].level_points
fields.meaning: Points toward a bonus of +1 to +9 (thresholds every 25 past 25); reset each morning; shown on the status screen (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0FAE (threshold bands), 4000:0D75 (daily reset), 4000:1AF3 (drawn)

fields.name: char[0].list_count
fields.meaning: Number of used entries (0-170) in this character queue at 0x0010; shown on the status screen (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)

fields.name: char[0].album_bits
fields.meaning: Bit flags; bits 0-2 of records 1-7 unlock entries in the album flags at 0x7810 via a fixed table (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:3495 (table 34E9, first 7 records only)

fields.name: char[0].daily_value_b
fields.meaning: Reset to 0 each morning; no other use found (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0D75 only

fields.name: char[0].stat_a
fields.meaning: Value shown on the status screen; reset each morning (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:1AF3 (drawn), 4000:0D75 (reset)

fields.name: char[0].stat_b
fields.meaning: Value shown on the status screen; reset each morning (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:1AF3 (drawn), 4000:0D75 (reset)

fields.name: char[0].order
fields.meaning: Order/slot number 0-10 from a fixed table; renumbered when a character joins; 0xFF = none (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0D20 (ROM table 104A), 4000:0FF9 (renumber on join)

fields.name: char[0].init_10
fields.meaning: Set to 10 at new game and kept across days; meaning not found (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0D20; constant 0A across saves

fields.name: char[0].daily_value_c
fields.meaning: Reset to 0 each morning; no other use found (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0D75 only

fields.name: char[0].wait_seconds
fields.meaning: Seconds counter (0-59, wraps) advanced for waiting-group characters that have not joined (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:107C; diffs: records 7-11 advance 00 -> 13 -> 1C -> 2E -> 32 -> 34 across successive autosaves

fields.name: char[0].wait_cycle
fields.meaning: Cycle counter 10 down to 0, one step per wait_seconds wrap, then back to 10 (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:107C (decrement + reset); constant 0A in saves so far

fields.name: char[0].with_seconds_a
fields.meaning: Seconds counter (0-59) advanced while the character is with the player; each wrap drops the countdown below by 1 (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)

fields.name: char[0].with_countdown
fields.meaning: Counts down by 1 per with_seconds_a wrap while the character is with the player (stops at 0) (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)

fields.name: char[0].with_seconds_b
fields.meaning: Seconds counter (0-59) advanced while the character is with the player; each wrap adds a minute below (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)

fields.name: char[0].with_minutes
fields.meaning: Minutes this character has spent with the player (stops at 65535); reset each morning (record 1 of 11; records are 19 bytes at 0x6019 + 19*n)
fields.evidence: code 4000:107C (increment, saturate), 4000:0D75 (reset)

fields.name: clock_flags
fields.meaning: Day clock flags: bit0 = clock running, bit7 = the day has ended (on the next continue a new day starts at 8:00)
fields.evidence: code 4000:00DF (tick gate), 4000:25B0 day-end site (sets 0x80 + saves), 4000:185E (new day on continue); 00 in every save seen

fields.name: clock_frames
fields.meaning: Frames left in the current second (75 down to 0)
fields.evidence: code 4000:00DF; diffs across saves

fields.name: clock_seconds
fields.meaning: Seconds left in the current minute (59 down to 0)
fields.evidence: code 4000:00DF; diffs across saves

fields.name: clock_minutes_left
fields.meaning: Minutes left in the day, starts at 480 and counts down; shown as the clock (479 = 07:59 in the verified save)
fields.evidence: code 4000:00DF (tick), 4000:0380/185E (set 480); diffs 480 -> 479; room screenshots 08:00 / 07:59

fields.name: clock_minutes_played
fields.meaning: Minutes played in the current day
fields.evidence: code 4000:00DF (+1 per minute), 4000:185E (reset at new day); diffs 0 -> 1

fields.name: event_flags
fields.meaning: One bit per event, set the first time it happens
fields.evidence: code 4000:0F97 (test-and-set bit AL in word); all 0 in saves seen

fields.name: counter_a
fields.meaning: Progress counter: counts up, and at 20 moves character record 5 into the waiting group
fields.evidence: code F000:7271 (increment, compare >19, set record-4 bit0); 0 in saves seen

fields.name: counter_b
fields.meaning: Progress counter raised by an event scene; past 9, character record 6 moves into the waiting group
fields.evidence: code 4000:6CC4 (increment, saturate at FF), F000:7289 (compare >9, set record-5 bit0); 0 in saves seen

fields.name: option
fields.meaning: A player setting: low 7 bits = 0-4 (default 2) changed with left/right, bit7 = an on/off switch; used as (value+1)*2 downstream
fields.evidence: code 4000:0380 (default 2), 4000:1F54 (menu edit), 4000:12CE (consumer); value 02 in saves seen

fields.name: partners_with_player
fields.meaning: Record numbers (0-10) of the two characters currently with the player; 0xFF = empty slot
fields.evidence: code 4000:5226 site (update), 4000:107C (per-partner timers), 4000:185E (cleared at new day); FF FF in saves seen

fields.name: items
fields.meaning: Up to 11 items: pairs of (item number, count 1-99), kept sorted by item number with empties last; FF FF = empty
fields.evidence: code 4000:11DB (add, cap 99), 4000:1215 site (use, clear at 0), 4000:122E (sort); all empty in saves seen

fields.name: name_history

fields.evidence: code 4000:9377 (prepend + drop duplicates), 4000:8D8C (preset pick into the name buffer)

fields.name: checksum

fields.evidence: recomputed OK on every save image in the play history (42+); code 4000:0356-035F (write), 4000:030C-0311 (check at load)
